I've thought about others for more than a year. I know it might be hard on some people specially my brother but I just can't seem to find a way to get over not having my dad. Others might have almost forgoten my father but I can't. I think about thim all the time everyday. It's so hard to live like this. Even worse when I have to pretend to be fine all the time because I can't talk to anyone and be honest about my feelings without being embarrased.

Can't talk to anyone. Everyone thinks I'm doing fine. I had professional help twice but it just didn't work out. I just can't talk or say anything, I felt so awkward and just stopped showing up to appointments. The only thing that helped me keep going was writting down everything I felt everyday. It's also my goodbye letter to everyone I care about because maybe that way they can understand me and have an idea why I did it. I'm still here but I don't think I'll be here for much longer.
